text: Dufferin Park Avenue sits at the top of Dufferin Grove Park and connects residents to fun park activities, students to St. Mary Catholic Academy, and visitors to popular events in the new clubhouse. I have heard from residents and Parks and Recreation staff that limited parking on Dufferin Park Avenue is creating challenges for programming and deliveries. Currently, parking is prohibited at all times on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, and for a large section on the south side. This has reduced parking availability and created significant challenges for Parks and Recreation staff, who face difficulty accessing the park for work and programming. Transportation Services determined that amendments to the on-street parking restrictions will create additional on-street parking spaces. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and a point 48.8 metres further east. 2. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and a point 30.5 metres further east. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and the east end. 4. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and a point 15 metres east. 5. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between a point 43 meters east of Dufferin Street and the east end.
